issues.message: Surface PEC copper, rectangular board bounds, selected nets and a finite absorbing region need mesh convergence and physical correlation.
Imported dielectric loss tangent was not represented; insertion loss is incomplete.
Explicit return-net shorting vias use solid PEC cylinders; barrels, drills and antipads are not resolved.
Selected source copper graphics had no net assignment; their antenna-net attribution is a documented model assumption.
The reference plane is an idealized rectangle over source ground extents; source voids and detailed return paths are omitted.
Overlapping same-net copper polygons were sent without planar fragmentation; inspect the resulting mesh for seams or duplicates.
Relative far-field pattern is not a calibrated EMI compliance prediction.
